title: Expressing sin(2*pi - x) in Terms of sin x and cos x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the sine difference formula to express \sin(2\pi - x) in terms of \sin x and \cos x.

steps.title: Expand Using the Sine Difference Formula
steps.explanation: Apply sin(A - B) = sin A cos B - cos A sin B with A = 2*pi and B = x.
steps.why: The sine difference identity expands sin(2*pi - x) into products at 2*pi and x.

steps.title: Evaluate Sine and Cosine at 2*pi
steps.explanation: At 2*pi radians, the point on the unit circle is (1, 0).

steps.title: Substitute and Simplify
steps.explanation: Substitute the values to obtain -sin x.
steps.why: By 2*pi-periodicity and oddness of sine, sin(2*pi - x) = sin(-x) = -sin x.
